description: Two immutable buyer context versions for the SIRA hackathon causal proof.

v1.label: HubSpot CRM sync mandatory
v1.expected_reason: Product A HubSpot tier ($120/seat) exceeds $100 budget; Product B ($95/seat) supports HubSpot natively within budget.

v2.label: No CRM sync requirement
v2.expected_reason: Without CRM requirement, Product A Standard tier ($80/seat) is cheapest eligible option.

causal_proof: Changing one private fact (CRM_SYNC_REQUIRED) changes the winner from Product B to Product A.
